answer_text: The Cato KB does not document a specific numeric limit for how many BGP routes a Socket can receive from a neighbor before the session is affected. To reduce the number of routes advertised to Cato, you can use: (1) Advertise Aggregated (Summarized) Routes, and (2) Apply Route Filtering to exclude non-WAN prefixes. These options are described in the Step 2 article for reducing advertised BGP routes.
